unit_test_cmd:
# From vul4c/vul4c:4.0
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="/tmp/mv-bdsr-vul4c/CVE-2016-1838"
TEST_SCRIPT="/tmp/mv_bdsr_vul4c_project_test.sh"
rm -rf "$PROJECT_DIR" "$TEST_SCRIPT"
vul4c checkout -i "CVE-2016-1838" -d "$PROJECT_DIR"
cp -a "$PROJECT_DIR/source" "$PROJECT_DIR/source_patched"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR/source_patched"
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh apply "$PWD"
cat > "$TEST_SCRIPT" <<'EOF'
#! /bin/bash
cd $1

./autogen.sh
make CFLAGS="-static -g" CXXFLAGS="-static -g" -j32
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 2
fi
output1=$(make check -j32)
echo $output1 > ../tmp1.txt

make clean

patch_paths=($(echo "$2" | tr '|' ' '))
buggy_paths=($(echo "$3" | tr '|' ' '))
count=$((${#patch_paths[@]} - 1))

for ((i=0; i<=$count; i++)); do
    cp ${buggy_paths[$i]} ./copy${i}.c
    cp ${patch_paths[$i]} ${buggy_paths[$i]}
done

./autogen.sh
make CFLAGS="-static -g" CXXFLAGS="-static -g" -j32

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    make clean
    for ((i=0; i<=$count; i++)); do
        mv ./copy${i}.c ${buggy_paths[$i]}
    done
    exit 2
fi
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh before "$1" || exit $?
output2=$(make check -j32)
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh after "$1" || exit $?
echo $output2 > ../tmp2.txt


for ((i=0; i<=$count; i++)); do
    mv ./copy${i}.c ${buggy_paths[$i]}
done

make clean

if diff -q ../tmp1.txt ../tmp2.txt >/dev/null; then
    rm -rf ../tmp1.txt ../tmp2.txt
    exit 0
else
    rm -rf ../tmp1.txt ../tmp2.txt
    exit 1
fi
EOF
chmod +x "$TEST_SCRIPT"
"$TEST_SCRIPT" "$PROJECT_DIR/source" "$PROJECT_DIR/source_patched/parser.c" "$PROJECT_DIR/source/parser.c"
